name: @laserx/desktop
description: Secure Windows desktop shell for LaserX Design Studio

scripts.dev: pnpm build:electron && concurrently -k "vite --host 127.0.0.1" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron dist/electron/main.cjs"
scripts.package:win: pnpm build && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win dir && pnpm audit:packaged-identity
scripts.package:installer: pnpm build && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win nsis && pnpm audit:packaged-identity
scripts.package:installer:signed: pnpm build && pnpm package:installer:signed:prepared && pnpm audit:packaged-identity
scripts.package:installer:signed:prepared: cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false LASERX_REQUIRE_CODE_SIGNING=1 electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win nsis
scripts.package:installer:upgrade-fixture:prepar: cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false LASERX_REQUIRE_CODE_SIGNING=1 LASERX_PACKAGE_VERSION=0.12.99-beta.1 LASERX_PACKAGE_OUTPUT=dist-packaged-upgrade-fixture electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win nsis
